server.name: io.github.100xPercent/pop-pay
server.description: Runtime security for AI agent commerce. CLI + MCP server blocks hallucinated purchases.

environmentVariables.description: Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint for credential injection (default: http://localhost:9222)
environmentVariables.name: POP_CDP_URL

environmentVariables.description: JSON array of allowed vendor categories (e.g. '["aws","cloudflare"]')
environmentVariables.name: POP_ALLOWED_CATEGORIES

environmentVariables.description: Per-transaction spending limit in USD
environmentVariables.name: POP_MAX_PER_TX

environmentVariables.description: Daily spending limit in USD
environmentVariables.name: POP_MAX_DAILY

environmentVariables.description: Guardrail engine: 'keyword' (offline, default) or 'llm' (requires API key)
environmentVariables.name: POP_GUARDRAIL_ENGINE
